title: Kition Data Document Listing
description: GET /api/v1/data-documents?workspace_root=<root>. With the capability, the workspace file system is the source of truth: the runtime indexes every .kitable under the root that has no index row yet, and omits file-backed rows whose file is gone (their rows are kept so a restored file keeps its id). Hidden folders, dependency folders, and symlinks are not scanned. Without workspace_root the plain index answers. Clients must keep their own registration fallback until the capability is advertised.
